tasks.label: BeatDrop: Build Debug (Win32)
tasks.command: $vswhere = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'; $msbuild = & $vswhere -latest -products '*' -find 'MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $msbuild) { throw 'MSBuild was not found. Install Visual Studio Build Tools with the C++ workload.' }; & $msbuild '${workspaceFolder}\BeatDrop.sln' /m /p:Configuration=Debug /p:Platform=Win32 /v:minimal
